encoding_limitation: the registered licensing_table capability matches ONE compound construction key and can only emit reject_reconstruction for anything unmatched; the evidence-specific abstention reasons declared here are therefore DECLARED-BUT-UNREACHABLE pending a keyed-evidence capability — kept as the unit's honest abstention vocabulary, not as consumer behavior (audit finding, modeled on inc-hamza-carrier-licensing)

rules.text: fathatan written directly on an ordinary final consonant is spelled with a following unpronounced support alif; the alif is orthographic only and carries no sound of its own

three exact final-grapheme environments block the support alif outright: a word already ending in the tied taa, a hamza already seated on an alif carrier, and the variant final a-spelling; in each the fathatan is carried directly with no added alif

a hamza that is NOT seated on an alif carrier does not qualify for the hamza exemption; it still takes the support alif like an ordinary consonant, so the exemption is keyed on the exact seat, never on hamza presence alone
nunation and the definite article are a written contradiction; a token declaring both is refused outright, never resolved by preferring one marker over the other

the support-alif rule concerns only the a-form of nunation; the u-form and i-form marks are never licensed constructions in this table, and an unpointed final ending supplies no tanwin evidence to decide on at all

this table decides written support-alif licensing from exact declared final-grapheme/mark evidence only; it never infers case, definiteness beyond the stated ban, governor, function, or contextual meaning
